alerts.title: Jammu-Srinagar Highway shut again near Udhampur's Dewal/Samroli; Tharar stretch still blocked
alerts.summary: A fresh landslide near Dawal Bridge in Udhampur's Samroli area, and continuing slides at Tharar between Udhampur and Chenani, have kept NH-44 closed to traffic on and off through late July into August. Shooting stones, mudslides and slushy conditions in the Ramban and Banihal sectors have repeatedly stranded trucks and passenger vehicles, with restoration work ongoing on a single-carriageway basis.
alerts.impact: Direct FM/LM hit: NH44 is the sole road link to the Kashmir Valley — expect repeat multi-day TAT breaches for Srinagar, Baramulla, Anantnag hubs. Keep buffer stock pre-built at Jammu hub, flag Valley pincodes as high non-adherence risk, and hold NS flags during active closure windows until J&K Traffic Police confirm reopening.

alerts.title: South India VLTD truckers' strike: mixed/patchy response reported since Aug 1 deadline
alerts.summary: Truck owners' associations across the south had threatened an indefinite strike from August 1 over mandatory Vehicle Location Tracking Devices (VLTDs), panic buttons and rising toll/compliance costs. Reports since Aug 1 indicate a mixed, patchy response — some Karnataka unions report large-scale non-plying of vehicles while other pockets continued near-normal operations amid ongoing talks with authorities; a clean nationwide resolution has not been confirmed.
alerts.impact: Continue contingency posture at Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kochi and Coimbatore hubs — maintain 3-5 days buffer inventory and keep alternate LM/3P partners on standby for southern pincodes until unions confirm the strike is fully called off.

alerts.title: Kerala: 9-district red alert as floods, landslides bury homes in Pathanamthitta, Idukki & Kottayam
alerts.summary: Intense monsoon rain from July 31 into August 1-2 triggered floods and landslides across Kerala's Western Ghats, killing 8, leaving 8 missing and 13 injured; 27 houses were destroyed and 196 damaged, with 5,792 people moved to relief camps. IMD red alert covers Pathanamthitta, Kottayam, Idukki, Malappuram, Kozhikode, Wayanad, Kannur and Kasaragod, with rivers overflowing and roads collapsing in Pathanamthitta, Idukki and Kottayam.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk across Idukki, Kottayam, Pathanamthitta and Wayanad pincodes — flag worst-hit talukas as non-serviceable until roads are cleared. Pre-build buffer stock at Kochi/Kottayam hubs and coordinate with Delhivery/Shadowfax for alternate routing around collapsed roads.

alerts.title: Dakshina Kannada: landslide near Kajila on Kaikamba-BC Road; rivers in spate, ghat routes on alert
alerts.summary: Torrential rain across coastal Karnataka's Dakshina Kannada district triggered a landslide near Kajila on the Kaikamba–BC Road highway (Aug 4) and an earlier slide between Yedakumeri and Shiribagilu railway stations near Mangaluru (Aug 2). The Netravathi, Kumaradhara, Phalguni and Somavathi rivers are flowing near or above danger marks, threatening riverside settlements; SDRF/NDRF are on high alert and earthmovers are stationed on the Charmadi, Shiradi and Sampaje ghat routes.
alerts.impact: Watch list for Mangaluru hub linehaul via Shiradi/Charmadi/Sampaje ghats — build extra transit buffer and pre-clear alternate routing with Delhivery/Xpressbees. Flag Kaikamba-BC Road-adjacent pincodes for possible short TAT extensions.

alerts.title: Bengaluru: IMD heavy-rain alert flags waterlogging risk in Bellandur, Outer Ring Road belt
alerts.summary: IMD issued a heavy-rain alert for Bengaluru on August 4, warning of intense evening thunderstorms, waterlogging in low-lying areas such as Bellandur and stretches of the Outer Ring Road, fallen trees and power disruption risk in eastern and southern parts of the city.
alerts.impact: Early-warning watch: pre-position LM riders away from Bellandur/ORR low points during evening storm windows and keep SLA-relaxation messaging ready for east/south Bengaluru pincodes if waterlogging recurs.

alerts.title: Assam floods: death toll hits 95, Sivasagar, Golaghat & Charaideo worst-hit as 14 districts on alert
alerts.summary: Assam's flood death toll has risen to 95 with roughly 1.6 lakh people affected across 14 districts as of Aug 6. Charaideo (77,456 affected), Sivasagar (63,492) and Jorhat (34,067) are worst-hit; the Dikhow river at Sivasagar and Numaligarh, and the Dhansiri river, are in severe flood. Golaghat is showing improvement but families remain displaced and are demanding an alternate drainage channel; over 17,000 hectares of cropland are submerged and rail lines are down in parts.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk across Charaideo, Sivasagar, Golaghat, Jorhat and Nagaon pincodes — extend NS flags and monitor Guwahati hub inbound linehaul for rail-linked delays; coordinate contingency LM capacity with Delhivery/Xpressbees for alternate NE routing.

alerts.title: Manipur: flash floods swamp Churachandpur's Kerith village and Ukhrul's Chingjaroi as rivers overflow
alerts.summary: Two days of relentless rain triggered flash floods across Manipur's hill districts. Ukhrul district recorded the highest rainfall (91.6mm); Kerith village in Churachandpur was inundated by the overflowing Khuga River, prompting the DC to distribute relief, while villages including Chingjaroi in northern Ukhrul saw some of their worst floods in years, submerging paddy fields along the Rangazak Kong river.
alerts.impact: Watch list — Churachandpur and Ukhrul hill-district pincodes at risk of road washouts; flag Kerith and Chingjaroi-adjacent delivery points as short-term non-serviceable and monitor Imphal hub linehaul for delays.

alerts.title: IMD red alert for Meghalaya & Sikkim, orange alert for Arunachal, Nagaland, Mizoram, Tripura, Bihar
alerts.summary: IMD's Aug 5 bulletin placed Meghalaya, sub-Himalayan West Bengal and Sikkim under red alert for extremely heavy rainfall, with Arunachal Pradesh, Bihar, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura under orange alert for heavy to very heavy rain over the following five days, raising flood and landslide risk across the Northeast.
alerts.impact: Early-warning watch across NE hub network — pre-position buffer stock at Guwahati/Shillong/Agartala hubs and keep alternate routing plans ready in case red-alert districts see fresh road or rail cuts in the next few days.

alerts.title: Uttarakhand: landslide blocks Nandprayag route in Chamoli days after Uttarkashi cloudburst-hit region reels
alerts.summary: Heavy rainfall triggered a landslide blocking the Nandprayag route in Chamoli district; the district administration confirmed restoration work is underway to reopen the road. The incident follows a separate cloudburst-related bridge reconstruction effort connecting Uttarkashi to the Harsil/Dharali area, underscoring the hill state's continued monsoon vulnerability.
alerts.impact: Watch list for Chamoli/Badrinath-belt LM routes — hold buffer transit time for Nandprayag-adjacent pincodes until DM confirms reopening; monitor for repeat closures through August given ongoing rain.

alerts.title: Himachal: expanding landslide-dammed lake near Niri village in Kullu's Sainj Valley raises flood-risk watch
alerts.summary: Fresh landslides on the Jiva nullah in Kullu district's Sainj Valley continue to expand a landslide-dammed lake just downhill of Niri village, raising concern over a possible downstream flood if the blockage breaches; no major drainage intervention has been undertaken yet. Separately, an earlier July landslide and flash flood in Kinnaur's Lippa village damaged three houses, orchards and submerged a 100-foot iron bridge.
alerts.impact: Early-warning watch: flag Kullu/Sainj Valley and Kinnaur downstream pincodes for a possible sudden flood event; keep alternate routing options ready for Kullu-Manali corridor deliveries pending administration's monitoring updates.

alerts.title: Godavari in spate at Kaleshwaram crosses warning mark; road links severed to 100 AP villages
alerts.summary: Heavy upstream rain pushed the Godavari river past its warning level of 12.21m at Kaleshwaram (nearing the 13.46m danger mark), with Medigadda, SRSP and Yellampalli reservoirs releasing large inflows. In Andhra Pradesh's Godavari districts, road links to around 100 villages were severed and roughly 700 houses submerged; unified Godavari district villages report disrupted daily life as officials step up evacuations.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk across Godavari-belt villages in Telangana and AP — flag the ~100 road-cut villages as non-serviceable, pre-position buffer stock at Kaleshwaram/Rajahmundry-side hubs, and monitor Krishna-basin reservoirs (Srisailam) for a second wave.

alerts.title: Ganga erosion swallows villages in Malda's Ratua block and Murshidabad's Dhuliyan after Bhutni Char breach
alerts.summary: Persistent Ganga riverbank erosion continues to devastate Malda and Murshidabad districts; a breach at the Bhutni Char dam has caused fresh erosion in the Mahanandtola and Bilaimari gram panchayats of Ratua block. Villages including Kantatola have already been lost to the river, with Srikantatola and settlements in Manikchak, Kaliachak I & II, Farakka, Samserganj (Dhuliyan) and Raninagar among the CD blocks worst affected year after year.
alerts.impact: Watch list — flag delivery points in Ratua, Manikchak, Kaliachak and Samserganj/Dhuliyan blocks for gradually shifting addressability; coordinate with LM partners on ground-truthing pincode boundaries as riverbank land loss continues.

alerts.title: Kanwar Yatra 2026 (Jul 30–Aug 11): Delhi GT Road, Outer Ring Road, Singhu Border under active diversions
alerts.summary: Delhi Police's 13-day Kanwar Yatra advisory is in effect, restricting Heavy Transport Vehicles (except city buses) on GT Karnal Road, Outer Ring Road and near Singhu Border from Jul 30 to Aug 12. GT Road from Apsara Border to Yamuna Bridge closes fully to general traffic from 7am Aug 9 to 8pm Aug 12 for peak Kanwariya movement.
alerts.impact: Plan LM/FM linehaul around Delhi-NCR HTV restrictions now through Aug 12 — avoid GT Karnal Road/ORR/Singhu Border windows and pre-clear alternate routing for Ghaziabad-Delhi corridor dispatches, especially Aug 9-12.

alerts.title: Petrol/diesel hold at multi-city highs — Hyderabad petrol above ₹115, Mumbai diesel near ₹98
alerts.summary: Retail petrol and diesel prices remain at elevated multi-city levels as of Aug 5-6: Delhi ₹102.12/₹95.20 per litre (petrol/diesel), Mumbai ₹111.21/₹97.83, Bengaluru ₹110.82/₹99.56, Hyderabad ₹115.69/₹103.82, Chennai ₹107.76/₹99.55, Ahmedabad ₹101.81/₹98.13.
alerts.impact: Cost watch, no action yet: sustained high fuel levels keep pressure on 3P per-km rates. Track weekly for early signal on Delhivery/Shadowfax/Xpressbees fuel surcharge asks ahead of the next pricing cycle.
